long_biography.plain_text:
Yevgeny Prigozhin began selling hot dogs with his stepfather in St Petersburg as the Soviet economy opened to private enterprise. He subsequently acquired a stake in a supermarket chain, moving from street trading into ownership of a larger retail business.

The Wagner Group became the focus of his later public life. He established the private military organisation in 2014 and publicly acknowledged founding it eight years later. Its operations extended to Ukraine, Syria and several African countries. In June 2023, he led its brief rebellion against Russia’s military leadership. He died in a plane crash that August, aged 62.
